newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates drop to 21.50 pct in liquid mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates drop to 21.50 pct in liquid mkt.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates dropped 1.5 percentage points on Thursday in abundant liquidity, dealers said.
"All bids were met very quickly during trade," said Balazs Benczedi of WestLB Hungaria.
Overnight rates ended at 21.50 percent, down from Wednesday's close of 23 percent.
Benczedi added he did not expect the trend to continue unbroken as the end of the month and the deadline of the banks' two-week reserve period is approaching.
